brief: Slovenian banking and payments hiring is visible mainly through sector CATEGORIES on a handful of general national boards rather than any sector-specialist portal, which does not appear to exist for this market. The practical backbone is Optius.com (confirmed bančništvo-finance category with ~39 ads and named bank employers such as OTP banka, Addiko Bank and Triglav, plus a clean filter taxonomy and footer RSS) and Zaposlitev.info (banking category dominated by NLB, with per-category RSS and email alerts - the cheapest machine-readable feed found); MojeDelo.com is almost certainly the largest source but could not be fetched in this pass and remains structurally undocumented. The state channel is legally central - employers must notify vacancies to ZRSZ via the PDM-1 form and the ESS search engine claims 20,000+ daily jobseeker visits - but its operational portal PoiščiDelo.si is restricted to registered users, so the national near-census is not openly collectable and EURES or ESS open data are the compliant alternatives. Vendor-side and fintech engineering roles surface instead on IT surfaces (Optius informatika-programiranje, BetterCareer.si, Slo-Tech /delo, Računalniške novice) and through staffing intermediaries (Adecco, Trenkwalder, Kariera), while leadership moves are essentially invisible on job boards and must be covered by another cell.
